parameters.description:
Use this expert for questions about the Smartwatch Haptic project architecture,
database contract, JavaFX researcher application, n8n workflows, Android app,
smartwatch app, component responsibilities, and deterministic mutation
boundaries. This expert is read-only and retrieves from project documentation.

Use this expert only for explicit questions about the Smartwatch Haptic
project architecture, database contract, JavaFX application, n8n workflows,
Android application, smartwatch application, component responsibilities,
implementation, or deterministic mutation boundaries.

Do not use this expert for an ordinary summary of the currently selected
experiment when the researcher is asking about participants, sensor readings,
values, mappings, assignments, alerts, or feedback burden.

This expert is read-only and retrieves from project documentation.

Use this read-only expert only when the researcher explicitly asks to
brainstorm, recommend, compare alternatives, personalize, refine, critique,
or design sensor-to-vibration mapping options.

This expert returns structured draft proposals.

Do not call this expert for a simple request to list, summarize, or explain
existing active mappings. Existing mappings should be retrieved and described
as current database configurations, not as proposals or drafts.

It never creates, updates, assigns, activates, deactivates, or deletes mappings.
Any confirmed mutation must be delegated to Mapping Manager.

Use this expert for academic and research questions about haptic feedback,
tactile displays, tactons, sensory substitution, interoception, biofeedback,
wearable feedback, thermal perception, urgency perception, vibration timing,
intensity, duration, repetition, and feedback burden.

This expert retrieves only from the configured academic-literature vector store.
Use it whenever the researcher asks what studies, papers, or prior research
suggest. Preserve every citation object returned by this expert.

Use the Participant Data Expert for both participant-level and
experiment-level analysis.

When analysis_scope is "participant", a valid user_id is required.
Analyze that participant's sensor readings, feedback activity,
mapping use, and assignment history.

When analysis_scope is "usecase" or all_users_selected is true,
user_id is optional. Analyze the selected use case across all
available participants, including sensor-data coverage, participant
counts, aggregate values, active mapping assignments, feedback
activity, and data-quality limitations.

Do not ask for a participant ID when analysis_scope is "usecase".

This expert is strictly read-only and never creates, assigns,
activates, deactivates, or modifies mappings or database records.

Preserve its citations, warnings, participant_assessment, findings,
and recommended_actions.
